Printed edition: Alexander von Humboldt's Reise in die Aequinoctial-Gegenden des neuen Continents. 4, 1860, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/11748167bsb. Three passages of the Gutenberg text have 80%, 63%, 91% of their four-word runs in the scan's text.
